SPEC-0336: nw worker (gate-job, have, gc, info, ssh-command) runs gate jobs from a stdin header+bundle in private shared clones of a locked per-repo cache
Adds worker.py/cli_worker.py, the "Remote gate worker" WORKFLOW.md section, and 47 offline tests that cover every AC. The only change outside nw worker is a backwards-compatible wait_event_s kwarg on gate_slots.acquire.
tests_run: uv run pytest -q -n 4 tests/test_worker.py tests/test_worker_ssh_command.py tests/test_gate_slots.py tests/test_cli_gate_slots.py tests/test_agentic_gates.py tests/test_completion.py (142 passed, x3)
uv run pytest -q -n 4 tests/test_*cli*.py tests/test_*permission*.py tests/test_agentic_project.py tests/test_agentic_dogfood_config.py (171 passed)
manual: nw worker info --json; SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND='nw worker info' / 'nw queue run' nw worker ssh-command

ac_status.ac: valid header+bundle -> accepted, started, gate frames with .log/.json/.r<n>, done
git merge-base $NW_BASE HEAD on worker matches coordinator
env outside allowlist -> validate error, nothing runs; reused job_id -> claim error
two concurrent jobs, same repo_key/base.name, different base.sha each see own base
EOF mid-gate and EOF during slot wait -> done interrupted (no started in the latter)
held slot -> slot_wait then started once freed
log over 16 MiB cut to 16 MiB with truncated_bytes
have after job; gc --keep-days 0 removes refs, objects, job dirs; live job dir survives
ssh-command execs four allowed subcommands, refuses rest with exit 2
WORKFLOW.md documents mandatory dedicated user and absolute-path key line

followup_ideas: GateResult.tail reads the whole log, so a gate that prints one huge line with no newlines puts that entire line into the result tail (local runs and worker gate frames alike). Cap the tail by bytes as well as lines.
gate_files matches retry files by stem, so a gate named 'x.r1' would collide with the retry files of a gate named 'x'. Consider forbidding '.r<n>' suffixes in gate names in project config validation.
nw idea clock-in/clock-out is refused under NW_PERSONA_RUN, so campaign implementers cannot follow the AGENTS.md clock rule. Either exempt the clock commands or drop that rule for persona runs.
